headline: X-AuT reports progressive Qwen3-ASR encoder compression with modest end-to-end latency gains
summary: An arXiv preprint reports X-AuT, a progressive pruning and cross-scale recovery recipe for the Qwen3-ASR-0.6B audio encoder. Across ten public Chinese-English ASR benchmarks, the authors report that 18-to-16-layer compression lowered unweighted macro error from 5.61% to 5.27%; a 14-layer model used 20.7% fewer audio-tower parameters with 5.75% macro error. For that 14-layer model, the reported encoder latency fell 21.4% on an in-vehicle PPU and 11.4% on an H800, but end-to-end latency fell only 4.7% and 2.6%. These are single-run, author-reported results on one model family; no repeated-seed uncertainty or independent reproduction is reported.
